beats.label: Why women
beats.text: Women naturally tend to have **lower** **creatine** **stores** than men.

beats.label: Your brain uses it too
beats.text: Creatine helps your cells recycle **energy.** Your brain burns through a lot of it.

beats.label: The research
beats.text: Early studies link it to better **focus** under stress, like **poor** **sleep** or mental fatigue.

beats.label: After 40
beats.text: In postmenopausal women, creatine plus **strength** **training** helped build lean muscle.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Most brain studies are **small.** Promising, not proven.

beats.label: If you try it
beats.text: Most studied: **3–5 g** of creatine monohydrate a day.
beats.note:
Ask your doctor first if you have kidney
issues or take prescription meds.
